fields.description: Tick to include this rule in the AI prompt. Untick to disable without deleting.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Rules are applied in ascending order. Lower number = higher priority. Move critical or frequently-failing cases to the top.
fields.label: Order

fields.description: Describe what situation or data pattern the AI should look for in the document (e.g. how to identify the currency, where to find the reference number).
fields.label: Case Description

fields.description: What the AI should do when this case applies (e.g. which field to set and how). Be specific — vague actions give vague results.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: Internal note only — never sent to the AI. Use this to explain why the rule exists or what problem it solved.
fields.label: Reason
